Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 cnt number ;
begin
nullchk;
check_package_failure;
 select company into :company
 from contracts
 where contract_id = :ctrl_blk_2.contract_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) ;
 NEXT_ITEM ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select count(*) into cnt
 from contracts
 where contract_type = :ctrl_blk_2.contract_type
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and upper(company) like
 '%' || upper(rtrim(ltrim(:ctrl_blk_2.contract_id))) || '%'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) ;
 if cnt = 0 then
 show_error('1147') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 elsif cnt = 1 then
 begin
 select contract_id,company
 into :ctrl_blk_2.contract_id,:company
 from contracts
 where contract_type = :ctrl_blk_2.contract_type
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and upper(company) like
 '%' || upper(rtrim(ltrim(:ctrl_blk_2.contract_id))) || '%'
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1) ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
end ;

procedure validate_review (unitidparm in VARCHAR2) is
begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from pt_batch_det
 where unit_id = unitidparm
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id
 and reviewed_flag = 'N'
 and rownum = 1 ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('2223') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error;check_package_failure ;
end ;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_UNITS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_units (unitidparm in VARCHAR2,cont_type in VARCHAR2) is
 batchid VARCHAR2(14) ;
 begin
 select batch_id into batchid from units
 where unit_id = unitidparm
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id ;
 begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from batch_inputs
 where batch_id = batchid
 and contract_id = :ctrl_blk_2.contract_id
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_2.chapter_id ;
 if cont_type = 'PT' then
 validate_review(unitidparm) ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('2222') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1230') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
